description: The P0 shell. build.rs declares an app ACL manifest (ADR-0012) naming all six commands in generate_handler!, so this file's grant is now enforcement, not documentation: it names the five commands crates/serat-app/webview/boot.js actually invokes -- read_file, write_file, index_status, mark_first_paint, mark_vault_usable. open_vault is deliberately withheld; nothing in the webview calls it (F-342), it is invoked only from Rust inside setup, and granting it here would reopen surface removing it was meant to close. Widening this set is a threat-model decision, not a convenience -- see docs/03-design/adr/0012-declare-the-tauri-app-acl-manifest.md.
